profnum.title: Profile
profnum.remarks: The identifier of the location profile.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: A description of the location profile record.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group that owns the location profile record. To change this value, use the Select Action > Select Owner option.

type.title: Type
type.remarks: The type of profile that is associated with the location profile.

createdby.title: Created By
createdby.remarks: The person who created the location profile.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: The asset that is associated with the location profile.

changedbydate.title: Changed Date
changedbydate.remarks: The date and time when the location profile changed.

prodperiod.title: Production  Period
prodperiod.remarks: The period of time that is associated with the production data.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the location profile.

details.title: Details
details.remarks: The details of the location profile.

constpoint.title: Constraint Point
constpoint.remarks: The point in the production process that constrains production capacity.  Constraints can occur for different reasons, such as scheduling time for corrective maintenance.

createdbydate.title: Created Date
createdbydate.remarks: The date and time when the location profile was created.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The owner of the location profile record. Use the Select Action > Select Owner option to assign either a person or a person group to own the location profile record. To take ownership of the location profile process, use the Select Action > Take Ownership option.

classstructureid.title: Class Structure
classstructureid.remarks: The identifier of the classification structure.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the location profile.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the location profile record was created, or when the status of the location profile record changed. This value is read-only.

changedby.title: Changed By
changedby.remarks: The person who changed the location profile.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the location profile.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the location profile.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the location profile record. Valid statuses are in the PLUSGLOCPROFSTATUS synonym domain. The default value when you create the location profile record is Draft. Use the Change Status icon on the toolbar to modify the status of the location profile.
